name: @pryzm/plugin-component
description: PRYZM — the PLACED COMPONENT family (audit §12 Phase 4C / ADR-0376 D9 / C84 §6.2). THE JOIN: before this package no bus verb anywhere in the repository put a component definition into a project. Owns the ONE authoritative store for placed occurrences and the three verbs component.place / component.swapType / component.setInstanceParameter. The definition model lives in @pryzm/file-format and its parameter resolution in @pryzm/family-runtime; neither is duplicated here.
